primary_audiences: adult children researching or purchasing for parents
decision_contexts: older or middle-aged product user and self-purchaser
adult child decision-maker and purchaser for a parent
anti_stereotyping_rule: Do not infer inability from age or digital confidence; report only evidence-backed barriers.
health_claim_boundary: Do not infer medical validity, clinical effectiveness, certification or document authenticity, or individual suitability.
mutation_boundary: Read-only. No cart mutation, order, checkout or form submission, payment, account creation, or other state-changing action.

persona_context.first_time: Middle-aged or older first-time visitor assessing identity, offerings, intended users, trust, product route, next action, legibility, hierarchy, navigation, CTA, animation and complexity.
persona_context.high_intent: Evaluate an older self-purchaser and an adult child purchaser for a parent; seek product, intended user, price, package, promotion, trust, CTA, cart and visible checkout path, support, and exact safe stop point.
persona_context.mobile: Middle-aged or older phone user with ordinary or limited digital confidence; assess legibility, contrast, density, navigation, target size, labels, scroll burden, overlays, movement, precision, gestures, orientation, recovery, product, price, CTA and help.
persona_context.research: Digitally capable adult child researching for a parent; separate site-present information, website-linked support, and unknowns across ingredients, claims, evidence, documents, company, credentials, reviews, FAQ, boundaries, price, support and purchase path.

shared_focus: animation, auto-moving content, carousel timing, hover or gesture dependencies
hard-to-find product, price, trust, company, support or purchase information
product documents, certifications, ingredients and health/nutrition claim support
